goal.objective: Activate the canonical StegVerse separated v12 single-heartbeat carrier plus worker coordinator continuously on a StegVerse-owned or StegVerse-federated node using only node-local durable storage and StegVerse/native process supervision.
success_predicates: A sovereign continuous v12 carrier advances control/heartbeat-carrier-runtime-state.json from the immutable legacy HB29 cutover source
The separate WorkerCoordinator is continuously live and produces worker runtime/coordination evidence without carrier-granted execution authority
Controlled restart/replacement preserves carrier and worker continuity and the nine-predicate activation proof passes
No external scheduler, hosted process provider, GitHub token, or NON-TV/TVC credential becomes production authority
failure_predicates: control/heartbeat-state.json is mutated beyond the immutable legacy HB29 source instead of using the v12 carrier state
Only the carrier is live while the required separate WorkerCoordinator is absent
A third-party platform becomes a required production dependency
Carrier or worker restart forks canonical state or duplicates a claim/fence
The worker repeats observation-only failure instead of deriving or escalating solution work
authority_ceiling: bounded sovereign carrier and worker-runtime activation only

Pre-heartbeat self-bootstrap removed initiation circularity; PR #203 repaired the G18 process-adapter liveness envelope; PR #204 repaired the one-host fallback so it supervises both separated v12 processes required by the activation verifier.

SELF_BOOTSTRAP_LOCAL_RUNTIME_ELIGIBILITY from scripts/bootstrap_sovereign_runtime.py before resident heartbeat existence

completion.next_authorized_action: G18 executes current main on an eligible non-hosted StegVerse-controlled local surface. Run scripts/bootstrap_sovereign_runtime.py; use the repaired one-host separated-runtime fallback automatically if native service activation does not complete. Completion requires node-local activation.latest.json with all nine predicates true, a live v12 carrier state at HB30 or later, a live WorkerCoordinator state, and immutable legacy control/heartbeat-state.json remaining at HB29.
terminal_when: control/heartbeat-carrier-runtime-state.json exists and advances from HB30 onward while legacy control/heartbeat-state.json remains unchanged at HB29
A continuously executing separate WorkerCoordinator is live and worker coordination evidence is present
The node-local nine-predicate activation proof passes
Controlled restart/reconstruction continuity passes for carrier and worker runtimes
No duplicate claim or fence exists and no GitHub token or NON-TV/TVC credential became production authority

constraint.machine_observable_completion_condition: node-local ~/.stegverse/heartbeat/activation.latest.json reports all nine predicates true and identifies live v12 carrier + WorkerCoordinator with immutable legacy HB29
